# Australian Public Service (Federal)
## APS Salary Guide by Classification
### APS 5 Salary
AnAPS 5 (also written as APS5 or APS Level 5) earns **$89,463–$97,837** gross — roughly $70,000–$76,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus15.4% employer super (~$103,000–$113,000 total package).

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the APS 5 salary?
An APS 5 (also written as APS5 or APS Level 5) earns $89,463 to $97,837 per year as set by the Australian Public Service Commission Enterprise Agreement 2024-2027. After income tax and Medicare levy, take-home pay is approximately $70,000–$76,000 per year.
